title: Looks really plastic and is not full at all.
text: Looks really plastic and is not full at all.. Ordered these ferns to replace silk ferns in hanging baskets on front porch.  Older ferns had faded due to sunlight.  These definitely look plastic.  I ordered six set to fill four hanging medium sized baskets.  I was only able to fill three baskets as stems are sparse.  Plan on ordering double what you think you need.  Not such a good bargain!
